message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
Calories can vary slightly depending on the tomato’s size and variety:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 18–20    |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22–24    |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 30–32    |

These values are for raw, fresh tomatoes. Cooking methods (e.g., roasting, sautéing) or added ingredients (oil, salt, sugar) will increase the calorie count.
